name: Toon Cannon Soldier
extDescription: This card cannot attack during the turn that it is Normal Summoned, Flip Summoned, or Special Summoned. When Toon World on the field is destroyed, destroy this card. If Toon World is on your side of the field and your opponent does not control a Toon Monster, this card can attack your opponent''s Life Points directly. Tribute 1 monster on your side of the field to inflict 500 points of damage to your opponent''s Life Points.

name: Toon Table of Contents
extDescription: Add 1 card from your Deck to your hand that includes Toon in its card name, or is named Manga Ryu-Ran.

name: Fusion Sage
extDescription: Add 1 Polymerization card from your Deck to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Royal Decree
extDescription: While this card is face-up on the field, negate the effects of all Trap Cards on the field except this card.

name: Spear Dragon
extDescription: When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent''s Life Points. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Damage Step.

name: Airknight Parshath
extDescription: When this card attacks with an ATK that is higher than the DEF of a Defense Position monster, inflict the difference as Battle Damage to your opponent''s Life Points. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent''s Life Points, draw 1 card from your Deck.

name: Susa Soldier
extDescription: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner''s hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. The Battle Damage this card inflicts to your opponent''s Life Points is halved.

name: Yamata Dragon
extDescription: This card cannot be Special Summoned. This card returns to the owner''s hand during the End Phase of the turn that this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up. When this card inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent''s Life Points, draw cards from your Deck until you have 5 cards in your hand.

name: Dark Balter the Terrible
extDescription:
Possessed Dark Soul + Frontier Wiseman
A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. When a Normal Spell Card is activated, negate the effect by paying 1000 Life Points. The effect of an Effect Monster that this monster destroys as a result of battle is negated.

name: Emergency Provisions
extDescription: Send Spell or Trap Cards on your side of the field to the Graveyard except this card. Increase your Life Points by 1000 points for each card sent to the Graveyard.

name: Fiend Skull Dragon
extDescription:
Cave Dragon + Lesser Fiend
A Fusion Summon of this monster can only be conducted with the above Fusion Material Monsters. As long as this card remains face-up on the field, negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters. Negate the effects of a Trap Card that targets this card and destroy it.

name: Thunder Nyan Nyan
extDescription: If there is a non-LIGHT monster on your side of the field, destroy this face-up card.

name: Last Turn
extDescription: This card can only be activated during your opponent''s turn when your Life Points are 1000 or less. Select 1 monster on your side of the field and send all other cards on the field and in their respective owners'' hands to their respective Graveyards. After that, your opponent selects and Special Summons 1 monster from their Deck in face-up Attack Position and attacks your selected monster. (Any Battle Damage from this battle is treated as 0.) The player whose monster remains alone on the field at the End Phase of this turn wins the Duel. Any other case results in a DRAW.

name: Archfiend Marmot of Nefariousness
extDescription: An air marmot that has a nefarious horn and wings. It attacks by throwing acorns.

name: Sleeping Lion
extDescription: A ferocious animal that sleeps all day. Sometimes it''s better to let Sleeping Lions lie.

name: Nekogal #1
extDescription: A pussy-fairy. Contrary to her lovely beauty, she claws on her enemies.

name: Burglar
extDescription: A sly rat. He will come at you with his huge left claw.

name: Clown Zombie
extDescription: A clown revived by the powers of darkness. Its deadly dance has sent many monsters to their graves.

name: Tournament Pack 6 Booster Pack
extDescription: Each Tournament Pack 6 Booster Pack contains 3 cards.
